title: To‘liq sinov imtihoni: Speaking va Writing
goal_uz: Dars oxirida gapirish imtihonining uch qismini tartibi bo‘yicha ishlaysiz, vaqt cheklovi ostida Task 1 overview va Task 2 rejasini yozasiz, javoblaringizni to‘rt rasmiy mezon bo‘yicha baholaysiz va keyingi sinov uchun uchta aniq, ustuvor maqsad belgilaysiz.

scenes.title: To‘liq sinov: Speaking va Writing
board: Full mock exam: Speaking and Writing
(To‘liq sinov imtihoni: gapirish va yozish)
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda imtihonda vaqt va stressni boshqarishni, savollarni tartiblashni va maqsadli tekshirishni o‘rgandik. Bugun shularni amalda sinaymiz: gapirish va yozish bo‘limlarini imtihon tartibida ishlaymiz. Sizga taymer, qog‘oz, ruchka va o‘zingizni yozib olish uchun telefon kerak. Dars oxirida javobingizni rasmiy mezonlar asosida o‘zingiz baholay olasiz va keyingi tayyorgarlik uchun uchta asosiy maqsadni belgilaysiz.
scenes.say: Welcome back. Today is a mock Speaking and Writing exam, and then you'll assess yourself like an examiner.
scenes.say_uz: Xush kelibsiz. Bugun gapirish va yozish bo‘yicha sinov imtihoni, keyin o‘zingizni imtihon oluvchidek baholaysiz.

scenes.title: Birinchi nuqta: IELTS gapirish tartibi
board: Part 1: 4–5 min · familiar topics
Part 2: 1 min prep + up to 2 min long turn
Part 3: 4–5 min · abstract discussion
Face to face, recorded · 11–14 min
scenes.say_native: Birinchi nuqta: gapirish imtihoni tartibi. IELTS da siz imtihon oluvchi bilan yuzma-yuz gaplashasiz, suhbat yozib olinadi, jami o‘n bir dan o‘n to‘rt daqiqagacha. Birinchi qismda o‘zingiz, ishingiz, qiziqishlaringiz haqida savollar. Ikkinchi qismda mavzu kartochkasi beriladi: bir daqiqa tayyorgarlik va ikki daqiqagacha gapirasiz. Uchinchi qismda esa umumiyroq savollar muhokama qilinadi.
scenes.say: Eleven to fourteen minutes, face to face, in three parts: questions about you, a long turn, and a discussion.
scenes.say_uz: O‘n bir dan o‘n to‘rt daqiqagacha, yuzma-yuz, uch qismda: siz haqingizda savollar, monolog va muhokama.

scenes.title: C1 Advanced gapirish tartibi
board: Usually in pairs · two examiners · ~15 min
1 Interview · 2 Long turn with photos
3 Collaborative task · 4 Discussion
scenes.say_native: Cambridge C1 Advanced da gapirish odatda juftlikda o‘tadi: ikki nomzod va ikki imtihon oluvchi, jami o‘n besh daqiqa atrofida. To‘rt qism bor: qisqa intervyu, rasmlar asosida bir daqiqalik monolog, sherigingiz bilan birgalikdagi topshiriq va oxirida muhokama. Bu yerda sherik bilan muloqot ham baholanadi: uning fikrini so‘rash, qo‘shilish yoki xushmuomalalik bilan e’tiroz bildirish.
scenes.say: In C1 Advanced you usually have a partner, so interaction counts: invite their opinion, agree, and disagree politely.
scenes.say_uz: C1 Advanced da odatda sherigingiz bo‘ladi, shuning uchun muloqot muhim: fikrini so‘rang, qo‘shiling va xushmuomalalik bilan e’tiroz bildiring.

scenes.title: Birinchi qism: javob, sabab, misol
board: Answer → reason → example
2–4 sentences, not one word, not a speech
Natural: well, actually, to be honest
scenes.say_native: Birinchi qism oson ko‘rinadi, lekin ko‘pchilik bu yerda ball yo‘qotadi. Javob formulasi oddiy: javob, sabab, misol. Ikki-to‘rt gap kifoya: bir so‘z bilan javob ham, bir daqiqalik nutq ham kerak emas. Well, actually, to be honest kabi tabiiy so‘zlar bilan boshlash suhbat ohangini beradi. Yodlangan javoblardan saqlaning: imtihon oluvchi ularni darhol sezadi.
scenes.say: Give a direct answer, add a reason, then an example. Two to four sentences is about right. Not one word, and not a speech.
scenes.say_uz: To‘g‘ridan to‘g‘ri javob bering, sabab qo‘shing, keyin misol keltiring. Ikki-to‘rt gap yetarli. Bir so‘z ham emas, nutq ham emas.

scenes.title: Birinchi qism: namuna
board: Q: Do you enjoy cooking?
A: Actually, I do. It helps me unwind after work.
Last weekend, for instance, I made plov for my whole family.
scenes.say_native: Namuna. Savol: do you enjoy cooking? Javob: actually, I do. Bu to‘g‘ridan to‘g‘ri javob. It helps me unwind after work, bu sabab, unwind esa dam olmoq, bo‘shashmoq. Last weekend, for instance, I made plov for my whole family, bu misol. Uch gap, tabiiy so‘zlar va bitta aniq tafsilot. Imtihon oluvchi aynan shunday javobni kutadi.
scenes.say: Do you enjoy cooking? Actually, I do. It helps me unwind after work. Last weekend, for instance, I made plov for my whole family.
scenes.say_uz: Ovqat pishirishni yoqtirasizmi? Ha, aslida. Bu ishdan keyin dam olishimga yordam beradi. Masalan, o‘tgan dam olish kuni butun oilam uchun palov pishirdim.

scenes.title: Birinchi qismdagi xatolar
board: ✗ Yes. / No. (and silence)
✗ A memorised paragraph
✓ Could you repeat the question, please?
scenes.say_native: Uchta xato. Birinchisi, faqat yes yoki no deb jim qolish: imtihon oluvchi sizning ravonligingizni ko‘ra olmaydi. Ikkinchisi, yodlangan paragrafni aytish: bu tabiiy emas va savolga to‘liq mos kelmaydi. Uchinchisi, savolni tushunmasangiz, jim turish. Savolni qayta so‘rash mumkin va bu normal: could you repeat the question, please?
scenes.say: Don't stop at yes or no. Don't recite a memorised paragraph. And if you didn't catch the question, simply ask: could you repeat the question, please?
scenes.say_uz: Yes yoki no bilan to‘xtamang. Yodlangan paragrafni aytmang. Savolni eshitmagan bo‘lsangiz, oddiygina so‘rang: savolni takrorlay olasizmi?

scenes.title: Sinov: birinchi qism
board: 1) Do you prefer mornings or evenings?
2) How often do you use public transport?
Answer → reason → example
scenes.say_native: Sinov boshlandi. Telefonda yozib olishni yoqing. Ikki savolga javob bering, har biriga javob, sabab va misol formulasini qo‘llang. Birinchi: do you prefer mornings or evenings? Ikkinchi: how often do you use public transport? Har bir javobga taxminan yigirma soniya ajrating.
scenes.say: Question one. Do you prefer mornings or evenings? Question two. How often do you use public transport?
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi savol. Ertalabni yoqtirasizmi yoki kechqurunni? Ikkinchi savol. Jamoat transportidan qanchalik tez-tez foydalanasiz?

scenes.title: Namunaviy javoblar
board: 1) Definitely mornings. My mind is clearer…
2) Almost every day. The metro is quick and cheap…
Check: reason? example? natural start?
scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javoblar. Birinchi: definitely mornings, my mind is clearer before the city wakes up, so I usually do my most difficult work before nine. Ikkinchi: almost every day, the metro in Tashkent is quick and cheap, although it gets crowded at rush hour. Endi yozuvingizni tinglang: sabab va misol bormi, tabiiy boshlanish bormi?
scenes.say: Definitely mornings. My mind is clearer, so I do my hardest work before nine. Almost every day. The metro is quick and cheap, although it gets crowded.
scenes.say_uz: Albatta, ertalab. Fikrim tiniqroq, shuning uchun eng qiyin ishimni to‘qqizgacha qilaman. Deyarli har kuni. Metro tez va arzon, garchi odam ko‘p bo‘lsa ham.

scenes.title: Ikkinchi qism: uzun monolog
board: 1 minute: notes, not sentences
Follow the prompts; add a story
Keep going until the examiner stops you
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi qism: kartochkada mavzu va to‘rtta yordamchi band bo‘ladi. Bir daqiqalik tayyorgarlikda to‘liq gap yozmang, faqat kalit so‘zlar. Bandlar bo‘yicha boring, lekin javobga kichik hikoya va tafsilotlar qo‘shing: qachon, qayerda, nima his qildingiz. Ikki daqiqa uzun tuyuladi, shuning uchun imtihon oluvchi to‘xtatmaguncha gapirishda davom eting.
scenes.say: Use your minute for key words, not full sentences. Follow the prompts, but bring them to life with a short story. And keep talking until the examiner stops you.
scenes.say_uz: Bir daqiqangizni to‘liq gaplarga emas, kalit so‘zlarga sarflang. Bandlarga amal qiling, lekin ularni kichik hikoya bilan jonlantiring. Imtihon oluvchi to‘xtatguncha gapiring.

scenes.title: Kartochka va qaydlar
board: Describe a skill you learned as an adult.
You should say: what it is · how you learned it
· how difficult it was · and explain how it has helped you
Notes: driving · 2022 · instructor Akmal · roundabouts · freedom
scenes.say_native: Mana kartochka: describe a skill you learned as an adult. Bandlar: bu qanday ko‘nikma, qanday o‘rgandingiz, qanchalik qiyin bo‘ldi va sizga qanday foyda berdi. Qaydlarga qarang: driving, 2022, instructor Akmal, roundabouts, freedom. Beshta so‘z, lekin ularning har biri bir-ikki gapga aylanadi. Qaydlar xayolingiz bo‘shab qolsa, sizni qutqaradi.
scenes.say: Describe a skill you learned as an adult. Say what it is, how you learned it, how difficult it was, and explain how it has helped you.
scenes.say_uz: Katta yoshda o‘rgangan ko‘nikmangizni tasvirlang. Bu nima, qanday o‘rgandingiz, qanchalik qiyin bo‘ldi va sizga qanday yordam berganini tushuntiring.

scenes.title: Sinov: ikkinchi qism
board: Your topic: Describe a place where you like to relax.
Where it is · how often you go · what you do there
· and explain why it helps you relax
scenes.say_native: Endi sizning navbatingiz. Mavzu: describe a place where you like to relax. Haqiqiy imtihondagidek ishlash uchun darsni to‘xtating: bir daqiqa qayd yozing, keyin ikki daqiqa gapiring va o‘zingizni yozib oling. Agar to‘xtatmasangiz, hozir hech bo‘lmaganda qaydlaringizni yozing.
scenes.say: Describe a place where you like to relax. Say where it is, how often you go there, what you do there, and explain why it helps you relax.
scenes.say_uz: Dam olishni yoqtiradigan joyingizni tasvirlang. U qayerda, qanchalik tez-tez borasiz, u yerda nima qilasiz va nega u sizga dam berishini tushuntiring.

scenes.title: Namunaviy monolog boshi
board: Notes: Chimgan · weekends · hiking, tea · no phone signal
Open: I'd like to talk about…
Close: So that's why…
scenes.say_native: Mana namunaviy javobning qisqartirilgan varianti. U qanday tuzilganiga e’tibor bering: avval mavzuni nomlaydi, keyin bandlar bo‘yicha boradi va tafsilot qo‘shadi. Oxirida so, that’s why iborasi bilan xulosa qiladi. Sizning joyingiz boshqa bo‘ladi. Yozuvingizni tinglang: to‘rt bandning hammasini qamradingizmi, ikki daqiqa davomida gapirdingizmi?
scenes.say: I'd like to talk about the Chimgan mountains, about an hour and a half from Tashkent. I go there at least once a month. I hike for a few hours, then sit with a flask of tea and look at the view. There's hardly any phone signal, which, to be honest, is half the attraction. So that's why it helps me switch off completely.
scenes.say_uz: Toshkentdan bir yarim soatcha uzoqlikdagi Chimyon tog‘lari haqida gapirmoqchiman. U yerga oyiga kamida bir marta boraman. Bir necha soat piyoda yuraman, keyin termosdagi choy bilan o‘tirib, manzaraga qarayman. Telefon aloqasi deyarli yo‘q, rostini aytsam, jozibaning yarmi shunda. Shuning uchun u yerda butunlay dam olaman.

scenes.title: Uchinchi qism: chuqur muhokama
board: Abstract: society, trends, the future
Opinion + reason + contrast
Speculate: It's likely that… · I'd imagine…
scenes.say_native: Uchinchi qismda savollar shaxsiy emas, ijtimoiy bo‘ladi: jamiyat, tendensiyalar, kelajak. Bu yerda C1 darajasidagi til ko‘rinishi kerak: fikr, sabab va qarama-qarshi tomon. Taxmin qilish iboralari juda foydali: it’s likely that, I’d imagine that, it could be argued that. Bir tomonlama javob emas, balansli fikr bering: on the one hand, on the other hand.
scenes.say: Give an opinion, support it, and show the other side. Speculate with I'd imagine that, or it's likely that.
scenes.say_uz: Fikr bildiring, asoslang va boshqa tomonni ko‘rsating. I’d imagine that yoki it’s likely that bilan taxmin qiling.

scenes.title: Tinglash: uchinchi qismdan parcha
board: Examiner: Do people relax differently now than in the past?
Candidate: I'd say so, yes…
Candidate: …although it could be argued that…
scenes.say_native: Endi uchinchi qismdan parchani tinglang. Imtihon oluvchi savol beradi, nomzod javob beradi. Nomzod qanday iboralar ishlatganiga, qanday sabab keltirganiga va qarama-qarshi fikrni qanday qo‘shganiga e’tibor bering. Keyin uchta savolga javob berasiz, shuning uchun diqqat bilan tinglang.
scenes.say: Examiner: Do people relax differently now than in the past? Candidate: I'd say so, yes. My grandparents relaxed by visiting neighbours, whereas people my age tend to relax alone, with a screen. Partly that's because cities are bigger and people are busier. Although it could be argued that online gaming is social too. Examiner: Will that change? Candidate: It's hard to say, but I'd imagine there'll be a reaction against it.
scenes.say_uz: Imtihon oluvchi: Odamlar hozir o‘tmishdagidan boshqacha dam oladimi? Nomzod: Menimcha, ha. Bobom va buvim qo‘shnilarnikiga borib dam olishardi, tengdoshlarim esa yolg‘iz, ekran bilan dam olishga moyil. Qisman bunga shaharlar kattalashgani va odamlar bandligi sabab. Garchi onlayn o‘yinlar ham ijtimoiy deb aytish mumkin bo‘lsa ham. Imtihon oluvchi: Bu o‘zgaradimi? Nomzod: Aytish qiyin, lekin bunga qarshi reaksiya bo‘ladi deb o‘ylayman.

scenes.title: Tushunganingizni tekshiring
board: 1) What contrast does the candidate make?
2) What reason does she give?
3) Which phrases show balance or speculation?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savol. Birinchi: nomzod qaysi ikki avlodni qanday solishtiradi? Ikkinchi: bu farqning sababi sifatida nimani keltiradi? Uchinchi: qaysi iboralar balans yoki taxminni ko‘rsatadi? Kerak bo‘lsa, dialogni yana bir marta eshiting va javobni to‘liq inglizcha gap bilan bering.
scenes.say: One. What contrast does the candidate make? Two. What reason does she give? Three. Which phrases show balance or speculation?
scenes.say_uz: Bir. Nomzod qanday qiyos qiladi? Ikki. U qanday sabab keltiradi? Uch. Qaysi iboralar balans yoki taxminni ko‘rsatadi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) Grandparents visited neighbours; her generation relaxes alone with screens
2) Bigger cities, busier people
3) although it could be argued that · it's hard to say · I'd imagine
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: bobo-buvilar qo‘shnilarnikiga borib dam olgan, uning tengdoshlari esa yolg‘iz, ekran bilan. Whereas bog‘lovchisi aynan shu qiyosni beradi. Ikkinchi: shaharlar kattalashgan va odamlar bandroq. Uchinchi: although it could be argued that balansni, it’s hard to say va I’d imagine esa taxminni ko‘rsatadi. Bu uchinchi qism uchun ideal tuzilma.
scenes.say: Grandparents visited neighbours, whereas her generation relaxes alone. The reason: bigger cities, busier lives.
scenes.say_uz: Bobo-buvilar qo‘shnilarnikiga borardi, uning avlodi esa yolg‘iz dam oladi. Sababi: kattaroq shaharlar, bandroq hayot.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: bo‘laklab gapirish
board: Speak in chunks: / = short pause
There's hardly any phone signal / which, to be honest / is half the attraction.
Stress the key word in each chunk
scenes.say_native: Uzun monologda talaffuzning eng muhim jihati: gapni ma’noli bo‘laklarga bo‘lish. Har bir bo‘lak oxirida qisqa pauza, har bir bo‘lakda esa bitta asosiy urg‘uli so‘z. Masalan: there’s hardly any phone SIGnal, which, to be HONest, is HALF the attraction. Kichik so‘zlar, ya’ni is, the, any kuchsiz aytiladi. Bunday nutqni tinglash oson va u ravon eshitiladi.
scenes.say: There's hardly any phone signal, which, to be honest, is half the attraction. Short pauses between chunks, and one strong stress in each.
scenes.say_uz: Telefon aloqasi deyarli yo‘q, rostini aytsam, jozibaning yarmi shunda. Bo‘laklar orasida qisqa pauzalar, har birida bitta kuchli urg‘u.

scenes.title: Ovoz chiqarib takrorlang
board: I try to go there / at least once a month / usually at weekends.
So that's why / it helps me / switch off completely.
scenes.say_native: Takrorlang. Qiya chiziq joyida qisqa pauza qiling. Har bir bo‘lakda bitta so‘zni kuchliroq ayting: birinchi gapda go, month va weekends, ikkinchisida that’s, helps va completely. Kichik so‘zlarni yengil, tez ayting. Ikki marta takrorlang va yozuvingizdagi monolog bilan solishtiring.
scenes.say: I try to go there, at least once a month, usually at weekends. So that's why, it helps me, switch off completely.
scenes.say_uz: U yerga, kamida oyiga bir marta, odatda dam olish kunlari borishga harakat qilaman. Shuning uchun, bu menga, butunlay dam olishga yordam beradi.

scenes.title: Tekshiramiz
board: I try to GO there / at least once a MONTH / usually at WEEKends.
So THAT'S why / it HELPS me / switch off comPLETEly.
scenes.say_native: O‘zingizni tekshiring. Weekends so‘zida urg‘u birinchi bo‘g‘inda: WEEK-ends. Completely da ikkinchi bo‘g‘inda: com-PLETE-ly. At least once a month bo‘lagida at va a juda kuchsiz, deyarli eshitilmaydi. Agar sizning nutqingizda har bir so‘z bir xil kuch bilan aytilgan bo‘lsa, bo‘laklab gapirishni uzunroq matnlarda mashq qiling.
scenes.say: Weekends is stressed on the first syllable, completely on the second. And in at least once a month, the words at and a are very light.
scenes.say_uz: Weekends da urg‘u birinchi bo‘g‘inda, completely da ikkinchisida. At least once a month da at va a juda yengil aytiladi.

scenes.title: Ikkinchi nuqta: vaqt bilan yozish
board: IELTS: Task 1 (150+ words, ~20 min) · Task 2 (250+ words, ~40 min)
C1 Advanced: essay + one choice task · 220–260 words each · 90 min
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi nuqta: vaqt cheklovi ostida yozish. IELTS akademik yozishda birinchi topshiriq grafik yoki jadvalni tasvirlash, kamida yuz ellik so‘z, ikkinchisi insho, kamida ikki yuz ellik so‘z, jami oltmish daqiqa. C1 Advanced da birinchi qism majburiy insho, ikkinchi qismda maktub, hisobot, taklif yoki sharh orasidan tanlaysiz, har biri ikki yuz yigirmadan ikki yuz oltmish so‘zgacha.
scenes.say: IELTS: at least a hundred and fifty words for Task 1, and two hundred and fifty for Task 2. C1 Advanced: two texts of two hundred and twenty to two hundred and sixty words.
scenes.say_uz: IELTS: Task 1 uchun kamida yuz ellik, Task 2 uchun kamida ikki yuz ellik so‘z. C1 Advanced: ikki yuz yigirmadan ikki yuz oltmish so‘zgacha bo‘lgan ikki matn.

scenes.title: Task 1: umumiy xulosa
board: Intro: paraphrase the task
Overview: the main trends (no numbers needed)
Body: key figures, comparisons
scenes.say_native: Birinchi topshiriqning kaliti overview, ya’ni umumiy xulosa. Unda eng asosiy tendensiyalarni raqamsiz aytasiz: nima o‘sdi, nima kamaydi, qaysi biri eng katta. Overview bo‘lmasa, boshqa hamma narsa a’lo bo‘lsa ham, topshiriq bo‘yicha ball sezilarli darajada cheklanadi. Tuzilma: kirishda topshiriqni boshqacha ifodalash, keyin overview, keyin raqamlar bilan tafsilotlar.
scenes.say: The overview gives the main trends in a sentence or two. Without it, your Task 1 score will be limited.
scenes.say_uz: Overview asosiy tendensiyalarni bir-ikki gapda beradi. Usiz Task 1 balli cheklanadi.

scenes.title: Sinov: Task 1 overview
board: % of commuters by bike, City A: 2010 8% · 2015 12% · 2020 19%
Write ONE overview sentence.
scenes.say_native: Sinov. Jadvalda ikki shaharda velosipedda ishga boradiganlar ulushi berilgan: A shaharda 2010 yilda sakkiz, 2015 da o‘n ikki, 2020 da o‘n to‘qqiz foiz. B shaharda o‘n besh, o‘n uch va o‘n foiz. Bitta overview gapi yozing. Raqamlar shart emas, asosiy tendensiyani ayting.
scenes.say: City A: cycling rose from eight to nineteen percent. City B: it fell from fifteen to ten. Write one overview sentence.
scenes.say_uz: A shahar: velosiped sakkizdan o‘n to‘qqiz foizga oshdi. B shahar: o‘n beshdan o‘nga tushdi. Bitta umumiy xulosa gapi yozing.

scenes.title: Namunaviy overview
board: Overall, cycling to work became steadily more popular in City A,
while it declined in City B, so that by 2020 City A had overtaken City B.
scenes.say_native: Namuna: overall, cycling to work became steadily more popular in City A, while it declined in City B, so that by 2020 City A had overtaken City B. E’tibor bering: raqam yo‘q, lekin ikki qarama-qarshi tendensiya va eng muhim o‘zgarish, ya’ni A shahar B ni ortda qoldirgani aytilgan. Overall so‘zi esa imtihon oluvchiga bu overview ekanini aniq ko‘rsatadi.
scenes.say: Overall, cycling to work became steadily more popular in City A, while it declined in City B, so that by 2020 City A had overtaken City B.
scenes.say_uz: Umuman olganda, A shaharda velosipedda ishga borish tobora ommalashdi, B shaharda esa kamaydi, natijada 2020 yilga kelib A shahar B ni ortda qoldirdi.

scenes.title: Task 2: reja tuzish
board: 1 Identify the question type: opinion? discuss both views?
2 Decide your position
3 Intro · Body 1 · Body 2 · Conclusion
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi topshiriqda besh daqiqa reja uchun. Avval savol turini aniqlang: o‘z fikringiz so‘ralayaptimi, ikki tomonni muhokama qilish kerakmi yoki muammo va yechim. Keyin pozitsiyangizni tanlang va uni kirishda aniq ayting. To‘rt xatboshi eng ishonchli tuzilma: kirish, ikkita asosiy xatboshi, xulosa. Har bir asosiy xatboshida bitta asosiy fikr va uning misoli.
scenes.say: Identify the question type, decide your position, and give each body paragraph one main idea.
scenes.say_uz: Savol turini aniqlang, pozitsiyani tanlang va har bir asosiy xatboshiga bitta asosiy fikr bering.

scenes.title: Sinov: Task 2 rejasi
board: Some people think all university education should be free.
To what extent do you agree or disagree?
Plan: position + 2 main ideas
scenes.say_native: Sinov. Mavzu: some people think all university education should be free. To what extent do you agree or disagree? Bu fikr so‘raladigan savol. Pozitsiyangizni va ikki asosiy fikringizni kalit so‘zlar bilan yozing. Butun inshoni esa uy vazifasida qirq daqiqada yozasiz.
scenes.say: Some people think all university education should be free. To what extent do you agree or disagree? Write your position and two main ideas.
scenes.say_uz: Ba’zilar barcha oliy ta’lim bepul bo‘lishi kerak deb hisoblaydi. Qay darajada rozisiz yoki rozi emassiz? Pozitsiyangiz va ikki asosiy fikringizni yozing.

scenes.title: Namunaviy reja
board: Position: partly agree
Body 1: free education widens access → talent not wasted
Body 2: but full funding is costly → targeted grants
Intro: While free tuition would…, I believe…
scenes.say_native: Namunaviy reja. Pozitsiya: qisman roziman. Birinchi xatboshi: bepul ta’lim imkoniyatni kengaytiradi, iqtidorli, lekin kam ta’minlangan yoshlar chetda qolmaydi. Ikkinchi xatboshi: lekin hammaga to‘liq moliyalashtirish qimmat, shuning uchun maqsadli grantlar adolatliroq. Kirish gapi: while free tuition would widen access, I believe targeted support is a fairer solution.
scenes.say: While free tuition would widen access, I believe targeted support for low-income students would be fairer.
scenes.say_uz: Bepul o‘qish yo‘lni kengaytirsa-da, menimcha, kam ta’minlangan talabalarni maqsadli qo‘llab-quvvatlash adolatliroq.

scenes.title: Vaqt bilan yozishdagi xatolar
board: ✗ A memorised introduction that fits any topic
✗ Task 1 with no overview
✗ Under the word limit · ✗ Off-topic ideas
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta keng tarqalgan xato. Birinchisi, har qanday mavzuga mos yodlangan kirish, imtihon oluvchi buni darhol sezadi. Ikkinchisi, birinchi topshiriqda overview yo‘qligi. Uchinchisi, so‘z sonining talab qilinganidan kam bo‘lishi, bu ball yo‘qotishga olib keladi. To‘rtinchisi, savoldan chetga chiqish: yaxshi g‘oya, lekin boshqa savolga javob.
scenes.say: Avoid memorised all-purpose introductions, never skip the overview in Task 1, reach the word count, and answer the question that was actually asked.
scenes.say_uz: Har qanday mavzuga mos yodlangan kirishdan qoching, birinchi topshiriqda overview ni tashlab ketmang, so‘z soniga yeting va aynan berilgan savolga javob bering.

scenes.title: Uchinchi nuqta: gapirish mezonlari
board: Fluency and Coherence
Lexical Resource
Grammatical Range and Accuracy
Pronunciation  (each = 25%)
scenes.say_native: Uchinchi nuqta: mezonlar bo‘yicha o‘zini baholash. IELTS gapirishda to‘rt mezon bor va ularning har biri teng, ya’ni chorak ulush. Fluency and coherence: ravonlik va izchillik. Lexical resource: so‘z boyligi. Grammatical range and accuracy: grammatik xilma-xillik va aniqlik. Pronunciation: talaffuz. Ball shu to‘rttasining o‘rtachasi.
scenes.say: Four equal criteria: fluency and coherence, lexical resource, grammatical range and accuracy, and pronunciation.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rtta teng mezon: ravonlik va izchillik, so‘z boyligi, grammatik xilma-xillik va aniqlik hamda talaffuz.

scenes.title: Yozish mezonlari
board: Task Achievement (T1) / Task Response (T2)
Coherence and Cohesion
Lexical Resource · Grammatical Range and Accuracy
scenes.say_native: Yozishda ham to‘rt mezon, har biri teng. Birinchisi topshiriqni bajarish: birinchi topshiriqda task achievement, ikkinchisida task response, ya’ni savolga to‘liq va aniq javob. Ikkinchisi coherence and cohesion: xatboshilar, mantiqiy ketma-ketlik va bog‘lovchilar. Qolgan ikkitasi gapirishdagidek: so‘z boyligi va grammatika.
scenes.say: Writing has four equal criteria too: task achievement or task response, coherence and cohesion, lexical resource, and grammatical range and accuracy.
scenes.say_uz: Yozishda ham to‘rtta teng mezon bor: topshiriqni bajarish yoki topshiriqqa javob, izchillik va bog‘lanish, so‘z boyligi hamda grammatik xilma-xillik va aniqlik.

scenes.title: Band 6 va band 7 farqi
board: Band 6: willing to speak at length, but some hesitation and repetition
Band 7: speaks at length without noticeable effort; some less common and idiomatic vocabulary
Band 7: frequent error-free sentences
scenes.say_native: Rasmiy tavsiflarni soddalashtirib aytsak, gapirishda band oltidagi nomzod uzun gapirishga tayyor, lekin ba’zan to‘xtab qoladi va o‘zini takrorlaydi. Band yettida u sezilarli zo‘riqishsiz uzun gapiradi, kamroq uchraydigan so‘z va iboralarni ishlatadi, xatosiz gaplari ko‘p. Ko‘rib turganingizdek, farq mukammallikda emas, erkinlik va xilma-xillikda.
scenes.say: Band six: speaks at length, with some hesitation. Band seven: speaks at length without noticeable effort, with more varied vocabulary.
scenes.say_uz: Band olti: uzun gapiradi, biroz ikkilanadi. Band yetti: sezilarli zo‘riqishsiz uzun gapiradi, so‘z boyligi xilma-xilroq.

scenes.title: O‘zingizni qanday baholaysiz?
board: 1 Listen to your recording
2 Write down one minute word for word
3 Ask: pauses? repetition? errors? range?
scenes.say_native: O‘zingizni baholash uchun yozuvingizni tinglang va bir daqiqasini so‘zma-so‘z qog‘ozga tushiring. Qog‘ozda xatolar darhol ko‘rinadi. So‘ng har bir mezon bo‘yicha savol bering: uzoq pauzalar bormi, bir so‘zni takrorlayapmanmi, qancha gap xatosiz, murakkab tuzilmalar bormi, bo‘laklab gapiryapmanmi. Har bir mezonga alohida taxminiy ball qo‘ying.
scenes.say: Transcribe one minute of your recording. On paper, the errors jump out.
scenes.say_uz: Yozuvingizning bir daqiqasini qog‘ozga tushiring. Qog‘ozda xatolar darhol ko‘rinadi.

scenes.title: Javobni baholang
board: Q: Do you like reading?
A: Yes, I like reading very much. I like reading books. Books is very interesting and I read books every day, very interesting.
Which criteria are weakest?
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Ekrandagi javobni o‘qing va mezonlar bo‘yicha baholang. Qaysi ikki mezon eng zaif va nima uchun? Har bir mezon uchun bitta dalil toping: takrorlanayotgan so‘z, grammatik xato yoki boshqa narsa. Javobni inglizcha qisqa gaplar bilan ayting, xuddi imtihon oluvchidek.
scenes.say: Do you like reading? Yes, I like reading very much. I like reading books. Books is very interesting and I read books every day, very interesting. Which criteria are weakest?
scenes.say_uz: Kitob o‘qishni yoqtirasizmi? Ha, o‘qishni juda yoqtiraman. Kitob o‘qishni yoqtiraman. Kitoblar juda qiziq va har kuni kitob o‘qiyman, juda qiziq. Qaysi mezonlar eng zaif?

scenes.title: Javob
board: Lexical Resource: like, books, very interesting – repeated
Grammar: ✗ Books is → ✓ Books are; only simple sentences
Better: I'm an avid reader, mostly of crime fiction…
scenes.say_native: Javob. Eng zaif mezonlar so‘z boyligi va grammatika. So‘z boyligi: like, books va very interesting qayta-qayta takrorlanadi. Grammatika: books is xato, books are bo‘lishi kerak, va hamma gaplar oddiy. Yaxshiroq variant: I’m an avid reader, mostly of crime fiction, because I love trying to solve the mystery before the detective does. Avid bu ishtiyoqli degani.
scenes.say: Better: I'm an avid reader, mostly of crime fiction, because I love trying to solve the mystery before the detective does.
scenes.say_uz: Yaxshiroq: men ishtiyoqli kitobxonman, asosan detektiv o‘qiyman, chunki sirni detektivdan oldin yechishga urinishni yaxshi ko‘raman.

scenes.title: Tinglash: o‘zaro fikr almashish
board: Sevara: Your essay answers the question, but…
Tom: The paragraphs?
Sevara: …and you keep writing 'nowadays'.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog. Sevara va Tom sinov inshosini almashib o‘qishdi va mezonlar bo‘yicha fikr bildirmoqda. Sevara Tomning inshosida nimani maqtaganiga, qaysi ikki muammoni ko‘rsatganiga va qaysi biri muhimroq ekanini aytganiga e’tibor bering. Keyin savollarga javob berasiz.
scenes.say: Sevara: Your essay answers the question really well. Your position is clear from the first line. Tom: Thanks. But? Sevara: But the second body paragraph has three ideas, and none of them is developed. And you wrote nowadays five times. Tom: Which is more important to fix? Sevara: The paragraph, definitely. One idea, properly explained, with an example.
scenes.say_uz: Sevara: Inshong savolga juda yaxshi javob beradi. Pozitsiyang birinchi qatordanoq aniq. Tom: Rahmat. Lekin? Sevara: Lekin ikkinchi asosiy xatboshida uchta fikr bor va hech biri rivojlantirilmagan. Yana nowadays ni besh marta yozibsan. Tom: Qaysi birini tuzatish muhimroq? Sevara: Albatta, xatboshini. Bitta fikr, yaxshilab tushuntirilgan va misol bilan.

scenes.title: Tushunganingizni tekshiring
board: 1) What does Sevara praise?
2) What are the two problems?
3) Which should Tom fix first, and how?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savol. Birinchi: Sevara nimani maqtaydi? Ikkinchi: u qaysi ikki muammoni ko‘rsatadi va ular qaysi mezonlarga tegishli? Uchinchi: Tom avval qaysi birini tuzatishi kerak va qanday? Dialogdagi aniq iboralardan foydalanib, javobni inglizcha bering.
scenes.say: One. What does Sevara praise? Two. What are the two problems? Three. Which should Tom fix first, and how?
scenes.say_uz: Bir. Sevara nimani maqtaydi? Ikki. Ikki muammo qaysi? Uch. Tom avval qaysi birini tuzatishi kerak va qanday?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) It answers the question; clear position
2) Paragraph 2: three undeveloped ideas (coherence) · 'nowadays' ×5 (lexis)
3) The paragraph: one idea + explanation + example
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: insho savolga yaxshi javob beradi va pozitsiya birinchi qatordanoq aniq, bu task response. Ikkinchi: ikkinchi xatboshida rivojlanmagan uchta fikr, bu izchillik muammosi, va nowadays besh marta, bu so‘z boyligi muammosi. Uchinchi: avval xatboshi: bitta fikr, tushuntirish va misol. Sevara aynan to‘g‘ri ustuvorlikni tanladi, bu keyingi nuqtamiz.
scenes.say: Sevara praises the clear position. Tom should fix the paragraph first: one idea, explained, with an example.
scenes.say_uz: Sevara aniq pozitsiyani maqtaydi. Tom avval xatboshini tuzatishi kerak: bitta fikr, tushuntirish va misol.

scenes.title: To‘rtinchi nuqta: nimani birinchi tuzatish
board: 1 Task: did you answer the question?
2 Organisation: paragraphs, overview, flow
3 Systematic errors (the same mistake again and again)
4 Range: new words and structures
scenes.say_native: To‘rtinchi nuqta: fikr-mulohazada ustuvorlik. Tartib shunday: avval topshiriq, ya’ni savolga javob berildimi. Keyin tuzilma: xatboshilar, overview, mantiqiy oqim. Keyin muntazam xatolar, ya’ni people is kabi qayta-qayta takrorlanadigan qoliplar: bitta qoida o‘nlab xatoni yo‘qotadi. Eng oxirida esa xilma-xillik: yangi so‘z va tuzilmalar. Ko‘pchilik teskari tartibda ishlaydi va noyob so‘zlar quvib, asosiy ballni yo‘qotadi.
scenes.say: Task first, then organisation, then repeated errors, and only then range.
scenes.say_uz: Avval topshiriq, keyin tuzilma, keyin takrorlanuvchi xatolar va shundan keyingina xilma-xillik.

scenes.title: Fikr-mulohazadagi xatolar
board: ✗ Trying to fix 20 things at once
✗ Chasing rare words before the basics
✓ Choose 2–3 targets for the next mock
scenes.say_native: Ikki tipik xato. Birinchisi, sinovdan keyin yigirmata kamchilikni ro‘yxatga olib, hammasini birdan tuzatishga urinish. Natijada hech biri tuzalmaydi. Ikkinchisi, asosiy narsalar joyida bo‘lmasdan noyob so‘zlarni quvish. Ubiquitous so‘zi sizga xatboshi tuzilmasi yo‘q inshoda yordam bermaydi. To‘g‘ri yo‘l: keyingi sinovgacha ikki-uchta aniq maqsad tanlash.
scenes.say: Don't try to fix twenty things at once, and don't chase rare words before the basics are in place. Pick two or three clear targets for the next mock.
scenes.say_uz: Yigirmata narsani birdan tuzatishga urinmang va asoslar joyida bo‘lmasdan noyob so‘zlar quvmang. Keyingi sinov uchun ikki-uchta aniq maqsad tanlang.

scenes.title: Ustuvorlikni tanlang
board: Feedback on an essay:
A) 'informations' appears four times
B) Two body paragraphs answer a different question
C) Could use more idiomatic language
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Inshoga uchta fikr-mulohaza berilgan. A: informations so‘zi to‘rt marta. B: ikkita asosiy xatboshi boshqa savolga javob beradi. C: idiomatik iboralar ko‘proq bo‘lishi mumkin. Ularni muhimlik tartibida joylashtiring va har biri qaysi mezonga tegishli ekanini ayting.
scenes.say: Put these in order of priority. A. Informations appears four times. B. Two body paragraphs answer a different question. C. Could use more idiomatic language.
scenes.say_uz: Bularni muhimlik tartibida joylashtiring. A. Informations to‘rt marta uchraydi. B. Ikki asosiy xatboshi boshqa savolga javob beradi. C. Ko‘proq idiomatik til ishlatsa bo‘ladi.

scenes.title: Javob
board: 1) B – Task Response: off-topic paragraphs
2) A – a systematic error (information is uncountable)
3) C – range: only after the basics
scenes.say_native: To‘g‘ri tartib: B, A, C. B birinchi, chunki savoldan chetga chiqish topshiriqqa javob mezonini keskin tushiradi va bu eng qimmat xato. A ikkinchi: bu muntazam xato, information sanalmaydi, bir qoida to‘rtta xatoni tuzatadi. C oxirgi: idiomatik til foydali, lekin u asoslar joyida bo‘lgandagina ball qo‘shadi.
scenes.say: B first: off-topic paragraphs damage task response most. Then A: a systematic error, easily fixed. C last: range only adds marks once the basics are solid.
scenes.say_uz: Avval B: mavzudan chetga chiqqan xatboshilar topshiriqqa javobga eng ko‘p zarar beradi. Keyin A: oson tuzatiladigan muntazam xato. Oxirida C: xilma-xillik asoslar mustahkam bo‘lgandagina ball qo‘shadi.

scenes.title: O‘z maqsadlaringiz
board: My three targets for the next mock:
1) Task / organisation: …
2) A systematic error: …
3) Speaking: …
scenes.say_native: Endi o‘zingiz uchun yakuniy topshiriq. Bugungi sinov javoblaringizga tayanib, keyingi sinovgacha uchta maqsadni inglizcha ayting yoki yozing: bittasi topshiriq yoki tuzilma bo‘yicha, bittasi muntazam xatoingiz bo‘yicha, bittasi gapirish bo‘yicha. Maqsad aniq va o‘lchanadigan bo‘lsin.
scenes.say: Name your three targets for the next mock: one about the task or organisation, one systematic error, and one speaking goal. Make each one specific.
scenes.say_uz: Keyingi sinov uchun uchta maqsadingizni ayting: biri topshiriq yoki tuzilma, biri muntazam xato, biri gapirish bo‘yicha. Har biri aniq bo‘lsin.

scenes.title: Namunaviy maqsadlar
board: 1) Always write a clear overview in Task 1.
2) Check every subject–verb pair: people are, books are.
3) In Part 2, speak for the full two minutes.
scenes.say_native: Namunaviy maqsadlar. Birinchi: always write a clear overview in Task 1. Ikkinchi: check every subject and verb pair, people are, books are. Uchinchi: in Part 2, speak for the full two minutes. E’tibor bering, har biri aniq va tekshirsa bo‘ladi: keyingi sinovda ha yoki yo‘q deb javob berasiz. Improve my English kabi umumiy maqsad yordam bermaydi.
scenes.say: Write a clear overview in Task 1. Check every subject and verb. Speak for the full two minutes in Part 2.
scenes.say_uz: Task 1 da aniq overview yozish. Har bir ega va kesimni tekshirish. Ikkinchi qismda to‘liq ikki daqiqa gapirish.

scenes.title: Qisqa takrorlash
board: 1 Speaking: 3 parts · answer, reason, example
2 Writing under time: overview · plan · word count
3 Self-evaluation: 4 criteria, record and transcribe
4 Feedback: task → organisation → patterns → range
scenes.say_native: Takrorlaymiz. Birinchi: gapirish tartibi, uch qism, javob, sabab va misol. Ikkinchi: vaqt bilan yozish, birinchi topshiriqda overview, ikkinchisida besh daqiqalik reja va so‘z soni. Uchinchi: to‘rt mezon bo‘yicha o‘zini baholash, yozib olish va so‘zma-so‘z qog‘ozga tushirish. To‘rtinchi: avval topshiriq, keyin tuzilma, keyin qoliplar, oxirida xilma-xillik.
scenes.say: Know the procedure, plan under time, assess against the criteria, and fix the task first.
scenes.say_uz: Tartibni biling, vaqt bilan rejalang, mezonlar bo‘yicha baholang va avval topshiriqni tuzating.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi
board: Homework: full Speaking (3 parts, recorded) + Writing (60 min)
Score each criterion; list 3 targets
Success: on time, 150+/250+ words, all criteria scored
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: to‘liq sinovni bajaring. Gapirish: uch qismni o‘zingizni yozib olib ishlang. Yozish: bugungi jadval va insho mavzusi bo‘yicha oltmish daqiqada ikkala topshiriqni yozing. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: vaqtida tugatish, kamida yuz ellik va ikki yuz ellik so‘z, har bir mezonga ball qo‘yish va uchta maqsad yozish. Keyingi darsda C1 yakuniy imtihonini topshirasiz.
scenes.say: For homework, complete the full Speaking and Writing mock and score every criterion. Next time: the final C1 exam.
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifasi: gapirish va yozish bo‘yicha to‘liq sinovni bajaring va har bir mezonni baholang. Keyingi safar: C1 yakuniy imtihoni.

homework_uz: To‘liq sinovni bajaring: gapirishning uch qismini (birinchi qism savollari, ikkinchi qism kartochkasi va uchinchi qism savollari) o‘zingizni yozib olgan holda ishlang, so‘ng darsdagi jadval va insho mavzusi bo‘yicha ikkala yozish topshirig‘ini 60 daqiqada yozing. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: vaqtida tugatish, Task 1 da kamida 150 va Task 2 da kamida 250 so‘z, har bir mezonga taxminiy ball qo‘yish va keyingi sinov uchun uchta aniq maqsad yozish.

quiz.q: How long is the preparation time in IELTS Speaking Part 2?
quiz.why_uz: Ikkinchi qismda bir daqiqa tayyorgarlik beriladi, keyin ikki daqiqagacha gapirasiz.

quiz.q: What is the best structure for an IELTS Speaking Part 1 answer?
quiz.why_uz: Ikki-to‘rt gap: javob, sabab va misol eng tabiiy tuzilma.

quiz.q: You didn't hear the examiner's question. What should you do?
options: Say: Could you repeat the question, please?
quiz.why_uz: Savolni qayta so‘rash mumkin va bu normal holat.

quiz.q: How is the C1 Advanced Speaking test usually taken?
quiz.why_uz: C1 Advanced gapirish odatda juftlikda, ikki imtihon oluvchi bilan o‘tadi.

quiz.q: What is the most important element of IELTS Writing Task 1?
options: A clear overview of the main trends
quiz.why_uz: Overview bo‘lmasa, topshiriq bo‘yicha ball cheklanadi. Shaxsiy fikr Task 1 da kerak emas.

quiz.q: What is the minimum word count for IELTS Writing Task 2?
quiz.why_uz: Task 2 uchun kamida 250 so‘z, Task 1 uchun kamida 150 so‘z.

quiz.q: Which is NOT one of the four IELTS Speaking criteria?
quiz.why_uz: Task Response yozish mezoni. Gapirishda: ravonlik, so‘z boyligi, grammatika va talaffuz.

quiz.q: 'Books is very interesting.' What kind of problem is this, if the learner makes it repeatedly?
quiz.why_uz: Qayta-qayta takrorlansa, bu muntazam grammatik xato: books are bo‘lishi kerak.

quiz.q: After a mock essay, which problem should you fix first?
options: Paragraphs that don't answer the question
quiz.why_uz: Savolga javob bermaslik eng qimmat xato, u topshiriqqa javob mezonini tushiradi.

quiz.q: Which target is the most useful for the next mock?
options: Speak for the full two minutes in Part 2.
quiz.why_uz: Yaxshi maqsad aniq va tekshirsa bo‘ladigan bo‘ladi.
